This '''unidentified [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]]''' worked on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] for [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|its royal house]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was present in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] in the [[Time/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] had an unwelcome presence on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. This [[Droid/Legends|droid]] helped the group of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]], [[Neeyutnee/Legends|Neeyutnee]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to unlock what a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Nuvo Vindi)|tactical droid]] knew about the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]]. While they did not get the information on [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] out of the droid, Jar Jar happened to stumble across the solution.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref>
